cves.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Portal product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Runtime Tools).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle WebCenter Portal.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle WebCenter Portal, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle WebCenter Portal. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.9 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Oracle Corporation Oracle WebCenter Portal
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性

cves.description: A lack of authentication in the mobile app (APK v5.5.0) for Ghost Robotics' Vision 60 robot allows an unauthenticated attacker connected to the device's internal Wi-Fi network to gain unrestricted access to the web administration interface and the HTTP API. Due to the lack of authorization mechanisms, the attacker can view real-time camera feeds, control the robot’s movements, manage sensors (GPS, RTK, SAM, LIDAR), and execute critical operational commands (Play, Pause, Stop, E-Stop). Successful exploitation completely compromises the confidentiality, integrity, and physical security of the system.
